limits: Every retained invocation and all16 wave snapshots are included; invalid metadata stays explicitly marked.
Last-visible TTMP does not date the underlying trap, expose earlier hidden events, or exclude later events.
A matching instruction boundary is a sampled return/resume location, not attribution to a corrupting instruction.
Nonmatching PCs remain unassigned. Zero TTMP is permitted and does not prove no trap.
Cave and return-preload descriptions use executed CFG bank81; the linear disassembler resets its displayed bank at the added branches.
Asynchronous LDS completion and trap restart can differ from the synchronous sentinel; no repair or common training cause is inferred.
